Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. 8. Before using this medication, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, other antibiotics (e.g., penicillins, cephalosporins), or if you have any other allergies. 9. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. 10. This medication may reduce the effectiveness of live bacterial vaccines (e.g., typhoid vaccine). 11. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. 12. This drug passes into breast milk in small amounts. 13. Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. 14. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. 15. Keep a list of all the products you use (including prescription/non-prescription drugs and herbal products) and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. 16. This medication may interfere with certain lab tests (e.g., urine glucose tests), potentially causing false results. 17. If someone overdoses and experiences serious symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. 18. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. 19. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. 20. If you are using this medication for an extended period, lab and/or medical tests (e.g., complete blood count, kidney function tests, blood cultures) may be performed. 21. It is important to take each dose of this medication as scheduled. 22. If you miss a dose, consult your doctor or pharmacist immediately for a new dosing schedule. 23. Store this medication in the refrigerator or as directed by your pharmacist. 24. Do not freeze this medication. 25. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. 26.
